# Build New Preview Workflow

**Goal:** Turn user intent into a hardened, reviewable artifact.

**CRITICAL:** If a step directs you to another snapshot file, read it fully and follow it. No exceptions.

Subagents, when the capability is available, are an important part of this workflow. Use them as directed by the workflow steps.
If you need an explicit user instruction to run them, ask once now for the whole workflow run.

## READY FOR DEVELOPMENT STANDARD

A specification is "Ready for Development" when:

- **Actionable**: Every task has a file path and specific action.
- **Logical**: Tasks ordered by dependency.
- **Testable**: All ACs use Given/When/Then.
- **Complete**: No placeholders or TBDs.
- **Sufficient**: No known requirement, acceptance, dependency, or implementation gaps remain unresolved.
- **Coherent**: No unresolved ambiguities or internal contradictions.

## SCOPE STANDARD

A specification should target a **single user-facing goal** within **900–1600 tokens**:

- **Single goal**: One cohesive feature, even if it spans multiple layers/files. Multi-goal means >=2 **top-level independent shippable deliverables** — each could be reviewed, tested, and merged as a separate PR without breaking the others. Never count surface verbs, "and" conjunctions, or noun phrases. Never split cross-layer implementation details inside one user goal.
  - Split: "add dark mode toggle AND refactor auth to JWT AND build admin dashboard"
  - Don't split: "add validation and display errors" / "support drag-and-drop AND paste AND retry"
- **900–1600 tokens**: Optimal range for LLM consumption. Below 900 risks ambiguity; above 1600 risks context-rot in implementation agents.
- **Neither limit is a gate.** Both are proposals with user override.

## Conventions

- Every operational cross-file reference in this workflow is an absolute snapshot path. Open it directly; do not resolve it relative to a skill directory.
- `{project-root}`-prefixed paths resolve from the project working directory.
- Whenever this workflow captures or records a version-control revision, obtain the full canonical identifier directly from version control and preserve it verbatim.

This uses **step-file architecture** for disciplined execution:

- **Micro-file Design**: Each step is self-contained and followed exactly
- **Just-In-Time Loading**: Only load the current step file
- **Sequential Enforcement**: Complete steps in order, no skipping
- **State Tracking**: Persist progress via spec frontmatter and in-memory variables

599	## Epic 4: Timeline & History
600	
601	Users can see every Entry they've ever captured, from any source, in one chronological view with a live per-entry sync status — and never lose track of something they wrote, even offline or mid-session-expiry.
602	
603	### Story 4.1: Chronological Entry List with Origin Marking
604	
605	As a user,
606	I want to see every Entry I've ever captured, from any source, in one chronological list grouped by date,
607	So that I never lose track of something I wrote.
608	
609	**Acceptance Criteria:**
610	
611	**Given** Entries from manual, audio, and photo sources
612	**When** Meus Registros loads
613	**Then** all Entries are listed together grouped by date, each visually marked with its origin via the record card's spine color (manual=`colorPrimary`, audio=olive green, photo=gray — chat=`colorAccent` reserved for Epic 6, UX-DR18).
614	
615	**Given** the list is loading
616	**When** the `GET /entries` call takes longer than 300ms
617	**Then** skeleton rows show (UX-DR17); under 300ms, no loading UI appears at all (RNF01).
618	
619	**Given** the session expires while I'm viewing this screen
620	**When** the FR-2 overlay (built in Epic 1) appears
621	**Then** it does so without crashing or losing my scroll position (FR-17).
622	
623	**Given** the entries Hive box
624	**When** Entries are cached locally
625	**Then** it stores exactly what the server returned, keyed by id — no local filtering, joining, or sorting of the cached collection (AD-15).
626	**And** no swipe gesture is ever implemented on a record card — Entries are immutable, so no gesture may imply an edit or delete that doesn't exist (UX-DR28).
627	
628	### Story 4.2: Per-Entry Sync Badge
629	
630	As a user,
631	I want to see at a glance whether each Entry has synced,
632	So that I know whether my capture is safely saved.
633	
634	**Acceptance Criteria:**
635	
636	**Given** a freshly created Entry
637	**When** its write is in flight
638	**Then** its badge shows "Synchronizing" (ochre dot) until the server's write confirmation is reconciled, then flips to "Synchronized" (green dot).
639	
640	**Given** a write fails (network or any Failure-contract code)
641	**When** the badge renders
642	**Then** it shows "Synchronization error" (red dot) until a subsequent successful write reconciles it.
643	
644	**Given** the badge is in the error state
645	**When** I tap it
646	**Then** it retries that entry's write if the underlying code is retryable, or shows an inline explanation instead of a retry affordance if it is not (resolves PRD OQ-6).
647	
648	**Given** one derivation function in `entries/domain`
649	**When** any screen renders a sync badge
650	**Then** it consumes that function's output, computed from `Entry.serverRevision`, `Entry.updatedAt`, and transient per-entry write state — no screen recomputes the badge inline (AD-10).
651	**And** the badge's dot color is always paired with an accessible label reachable on tap/long-focus, and its tappable retry area is ≥44pt even though the dot itself is small (UX-DR7, UX-DR23) — color never carries the state alone.
652	**And** the badge's update stream runs independently of the auth/session stream — a pending sync-badge transition is never blocked or cleared by session-expiry handling.
653	
654	### Story 4.3: Empty-State Handling
655	
656	As a user with no Entries yet,
657	I want a dedicated empty state instead of a blank list,
658	So that the app guides me back to capture rather than looking broken.
659	
660	**Acceptance Criteria:**
661	
662	**Given** zero Entries exist
663	**When** Meus Registros loads
664	**Then** a dedicated empty state renders — never a blank list.
665	
666	**Given** the empty state
667	**When** I look for a way forward
668	**Then** it offers a path back to capture (a CTA that opens the Insertion Modal).
669	
670	### Story 4.4: Entry Detail View
671	
672	As a user,
673	I want to open a single Entry to see its full content,
674	So that I can review exactly what I wrote without any risk of accidentally changing it.
675	
676	**Acceptance Criteria:**
677	
678	**Given** an Entry in the list
679	**When** I open it
680	**Then** `GET /entries/:id` fetches and displays its full content with no edit affordance anywhere on the screen — Entries are immutable, and `EntriesRepository` exposes create and read only; no update/delete method is ever added (AD-11).
681	
682	**Given** an Entry that doesn't exist or belongs to another user
683	**When** the detail request is made
684	**Then** the backend returns `NOT_FOUND`, never a permission-denied code, and the UI shows the same not-found treatment either way (RNF04).
685	
686	**Given** this screen composes auth status, Sync Badge state, and Entry data
687	**When** those three streams are combined
688	**Then** they combine only through the domain layer — no BLoC in this feature imports another BLoC directly (AD-7, feature-specific NFR).

### Story 4.1: Chronological Entry List with Origin Marking

As a user,
I want to see every Entry I've ever captured, from any source, in one chronological list grouped by date,
So that I never lose track of something I wrote.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** Entries from manual, audio, and photo sources
**When** Meus Registros loads
**Then** all Entries are listed together grouped by date, each visually marked with its origin via the record card's spine color (manual=`colorPrimary`, audio=olive green, photo=gray — chat=`colorAccent` reserved for Epic 6, UX-DR18).

**Given** the list is loading
**When** the `GET /entries` call takes longer than 300ms
**Then** skeleton rows show (UX-DR17); under 300ms, no loading UI appears at all (RNF01).

**Given** the session expires while I'm viewing this screen
**When** the FR-2 overlay (built in Epic 1) appears
**Then** it does so without crashing or losing my scroll position (FR-17).

**Given** the entries Hive box
**When** Entries are cached locally
**Then** it stores exactly what the server returned, keyed by id — no local filtering, joining, or sorting of the cached collection (AD-15).
**And** no swipe gesture is ever implemented on a record card — Entries are immutable, so no gesture may imply an edit or delete that doesn't exist (UX-DR28).

### Story 4.2: Per-Entry Sync Badge

As a user,
I want to see at a glance whether each Entry has synced,
So that I know whether my capture is safely saved.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** a freshly created Entry
**When** its write is in flight
**Then** its badge shows "Synchronizing" (ochre dot) until the server's write confirmation is reconciled, then flips to "Synchronized" (green dot).

**Given** a write fails (network or any Failure-contract code)
**When** the badge renders
**Then** it shows "Synchronization error" (red dot) until a subsequent successful write reconciles it.

**Given** the badge is in the error state
**When** I tap it
**Then** it retries that entry's write if the underlying code is retryable, or shows an inline explanation instead of a retry affordance if it is not (resolves PRD OQ-6).

**Given** one derivation function in `entries/domain`
**When** any screen renders a sync badge
**Then** it consumes that function's output, computed from `Entry.serverRevision`, `Entry.updatedAt`, and transient per-entry write state — no screen recomputes the badge inline (AD-10).
**And** the badge's dot color is always paired with an accessible label reachable on tap/long-focus, and its tappable retry area is ≥44pt even though the dot itself is small (UX-DR7, UX-DR23) — color never carries the state alone.
**And** the badge's update stream runs independently of the auth/session stream — a pending sync-badge transition is never blocked or cleared by session-expiry handling.

### Story 4.3: Empty-State Handling

As a user with no Entries yet,
I want a dedicated empty state instead of a blank list,
So that the app guides me back to capture rather than looking broken.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** zero Entries exist
**When** Meus Registros loads
**Then** a dedicated empty state renders — never a blank list.

**Given** the empty state
**When** I look for a way forward
**Then** it offers a path back to capture (a CTA that opens the Insertion Modal).

### Story 4.4: Entry Detail View

As a user,
I want to open a single Entry to see its full content,
So that I can review exactly what I wrote without any risk of accidentally changing it.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an Entry in the list
**When** I open it
**Then** `GET /entries/:id` fetches and displays its full content with no edit affordance anywhere on the screen — Entries are immutable, and `EntriesRepository` exposes create and read only; no update/delete method is ever added (AD-11).

**Given** an Entry that doesn't exist or belongs to another user
**When** the detail request is made
**Then** the backend returns `NOT_FOUND`, never a permission-denied code, and the UI shows the same not-found treatment either way (RNF04).

**Given** this screen composes auth status, Sync Badge state, and Entry data
**When** those three streams are combined
**Then** they combine only through the domain layer — no BLoC in this feature imports another BLoC directly (AD-7, feature-specific NFR).

# Epic 4 Context: Timeline & History

<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->

## Goal

Users can see every Entry they've ever captured, from any source (text, audio, photo), in one chronological view grouped by date, each carrying a live per-entry sync status — and never lose track of something they wrote, even offline or mid-session-expiry. This is the first independently demoable milestone built on top of the `entries` feature Epic 3 introduced: a working, origin-marked timeline with reconciling sync badges, with no search or filtering yet (that's Epic 5). Depends on Epic 3 (there is nothing to list until Entries exist).

## Stories

- Story 4.1: Chronological Entry List with Origin Marking
- Story 4.2: Per-Entry Sync Badge
- Story 4.3: Empty-State Handling
- Story 4.4: Entry Detail View

## Requirements & Constraints

- All Entries from every source are listed together in one list, grouped by date, each visually marked with its origin.
- A list load that exceeds the loading-indicator threshold (300ms) shows a skeleton loading state; under that threshold, no loading UI appears at all.
- Zero Entries renders a dedicated empty state with a path back to capture — never a blank list.
- A single Entry can be opened to view its full content; there is no edit affordance anywhere on that screen, and no update/delete capability exists for Entries at all — read-only, permanently.
- A detail request for an Entry that doesn't exist or belongs to another user returns a generic not-found outcome, never a distinguishable permission-denied code; the UI must treat both identically.
- The sync badge has exactly three states (Synchronizing / Synchronization error / Synchronized), derived client-side only — the backend has no sync-status field. A freshly created Entry starts Synchronizing until the write is confirmed, then flips to Synchronized. A failed write (network or any error code) shows Synchronization error until a later successful write reconciles it.
- Tapping an error badge retries that Entry's write when the underlying error is retryable; when it isn't, it shows an inline explanation instead — never a dead retry button.
- The sync-badge update stream is fully independent of the auth/session stream: a pending sync transition is never blocked, delayed, or cleared by session-expiry handling, and the session-expiry overlay must be able to appear over this screen without crashing or losing scroll position.
- This feature's screen composes three data streams (auth status, sync-badge state, Entry data) only through the domain layer — no BLoC/Cubit here ever references another BLoC/Cubit directly.
- No swipe gesture is implemented on a record card (Entries are immutable, so no gesture may imply an edit/delete that doesn't exist).
- Color is never the sole carrier of sync-badge state — always paired with an accessible label, and the retry hit area must be ≥44pt even though the dot itself is small.

## Technical Decisions

- `entries/domain` (introduced in Epic 3) already owns the `Entry` entity, the `EntriesRepository` port, and the Hive box; this epic extends that same port with read/list operations rather than introducing a second Entry model or owner.
- `EntriesRepository` exposes create and read only, permanently — no update/delete method is ever added, matching the backend's lack of a mutating entries endpoint.
- One single derivation function lives in `entries/domain` computing the sync badge from `Entry.serverRevision`, `Entry.updatedAt`, and transient per-entry write state (no pending write → Synchronized; write in flight → Synchronizing; failed write → Synchronization error). Every screen that ever renders this badge (this timeline now, chat's save confirmation later) consumes that one function's output — none recomputes it inline.
- This screen's composite state (auth × sync × data) is its own sealed state class, not the shared generic single-fetch `Resource<T>` type used elsewhere — it has a composite, multi-stream lifecycle `Resource<T>` isn't meant for.
- Reads fall back transparently to the local Hive cache when offline; the cache stores exactly what the server returned, keyed by id — never locally filtered, joined, sorted, or re-derived. Pagination uses the server's own cursor convention verbatim, cached alongside the box it pages.
- A badge retry re-attempts the same underlying write call that originally failed; there is no separate retry endpoint for entries.

## UX & Interaction Patterns

- Record card spine color encodes origin: manual = primary color, audio = olive green, photo = gray (chat's accent color is reserved for Epic 6's chat-saved entries).
- The prototype shows the record card as otherwise display-only — tapping it previously did nothing beyond surfacing the badge's retry affordance in the error state. The detail view this epic adds (FR-18) has no prototype precedent; build it minimal and strictly read-only, consistent with the record card's established "no edit/expand implied" convention.
- Skeleton rows use the shared skeleton-loading component (never a spinner) and only appear past the 300ms threshold.
- Empty state must offer a concrete CTA back into the capture flow (opens the Insertion Modal), not just explanatory copy.

## Cross-Story Dependencies

- Depends on Epic 3: the `entries` feature, `Entry` entity, `EntriesRepository.create`, and the entries Hive box must already exist; this epic only adds read/list.
- Reuses Epic 1's session-expiry overlay (FR-2) as-is for mid-timeline session expiry — no new overlay is built here.
- The sync-badge derivation function built in Story 4.2 is a shared dependency: Epic 6 (chat's save-to-journal confirmation) consumes the same function rather than building its own.
- Epic 5 (Semantic Search & Filtering) is built directly on top of this epic's timeline surface and extends the same `EntriesRepository` port further with search — do not duplicate list/display logic there.

12	
13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** A capture write (Epic 3) is a blocking round trip with no trace on Meus Registros: a failed write vanishes silently (only the capture modal's own local error shows), and nothing on a listed card tells the user whether what they wrote is actually saved server-side.
16	
17	**Approach:** Introduce one shared in-memory `PendingEntryWriteTracker` domain port that the three capture cubits and `MeusRegistrosCubit` both consume. Capture cubits route `create()` through it (optimistic pending record before the call, resolved/failed after); `MeusRegistrosCubit` overlays the tracker's live pending writes on its confirmed list. One pure derivation function (`entries/domain`) computes each card's badge from `Entry.serverRevision`/`updatedAt` plus matching pending-write status, per `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`. Tapping an error badge retries through the same tracker when retryable; otherwise shows inline explanation only.
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:**
22	- New port + impl `entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart` (pure Dart, RNF06 — no Flutter/data import; mirrors `SessionExpiryNotifier` pattern). API: `Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source, int? mediaDurationSeconds})` (identical contract to `EntriesRepository.create()` today — capture cubits swap the dependency, no call-site logic change); `Future<void> retry(String tempId)`; `Stream<List<PendingEntryWrite>> get pendingWrites` — replay-capable (`Stream.multi` + cached last value, mirror `SessionRepositoryImpl.statusStream`, `session_repository_impl.dart:69-89`) so a late subscriber sees current pending state immediately.
23	- New value class `entries/domain/entities/pending_entry_write.dart`: `{tempId, content, source, mediaDurationSeconds, startedAt, status}`, `status` = `inFlight` or `failed(Failure)`. On `create()` success: tracker drops the record; `MeusRegistrosCubit` prepends the confirmed `Entry` into its own state (existing `_dedupedById` absorbs a later duplicate from `list()`). On failure: record flips `failed`, persists only in memory until `retry()` succeeds (no queued/offline write — UX-DR30, sync-badge.md: nothing survives restart).
24	- `create()` first drops any existing `failed`-status record before registering the new `inFlight` one (never more than one failed record at a time). Safe because exactly one Insertion Modal exists app-wide (one factory-scoped cubit, reset on each open — UX-DR26, UX-DR36), so there is only ever one "live" capture lineage: a user retrying by tapping "Salvar" again in the same still-open modal (not via the badge) must not leave the superseded attempt's error card as a permanent orphan on Meus Registros.
25	- One derivation fn `deriveSyncBadgeState(Entry? entry, PendingEntryWrite? pending)` in `entries/domain/entities/sync_badge_state.dart`, pure, returns sealed `SyncBadgeState` (`synchronizing | synchronized | error(Failure)`) (AD-10) — the only place this logic lives.
26	- Register tracker `lazySingleton` in `entries_injection.dart` (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s own registration); inject into `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`/`PhotoEntryCubit` (`capture_injection.dart`, replacing their direct `EntriesRepository.create()` call) and into `MeusRegistrosCubit` — constructor injection only, never cubit-to-cubit (AD-7).
27	- `EntryRecordCard` gains a badge (dot: `colorWarningSync`/`colorSuccess`/`colorError`, `design_tokens.dart:51,54,57`) + accessible label on tap/long-focus; retry hit area uses `DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin` (`design_tokens.dart:283`), scoped to the badge's own sub-widget only — the card itself stays non-tappable-for-navigation (Story 4.4's job).
28	- Tap on `error` badge: if `failure.retryable` (existing getter, `lib/core/failure/failure.dart`) call `tracker.retry(tempId)`; else render inline explanation text, no tap affordance.
29	
30	**Ask First:** none — scope above is complete per investigation.
31	
32	**Never:** persisting pending writes; a second retry endpoint (retry replays `create()` verbatim); any screen recomputing badge state inline; `EntryRecordCard` becoming navigation-tappable.
33	
34	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
35	
36	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
37	|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
38	| Fresh save | Capture cubit calls `tracker.create()` | Card appears top-of-today, ochre "Synchronizing" badge, before server responds | N/A |
39	| Write confirmed | `create()` resolves `Right(entry)` | Pending record removed, entry prepended, badge flips green "Synchronized" | N/A |
40	| Write fails, retryable | `create()` resolves `Left(networkTimeout)` | Card stays, red "Synchronization error" badge | Tap calls `tracker.retry(tempId)`, re-sends same payload |
41	| Write fails, non-retryable | `create()` resolves `Left(validation)` | Red badge, inline explanation on tap | No network call on tap |
42	| App restarts mid-pending | Pending write existed, app killed | Pending card is gone (not persisted) | N/A |
43	
44	</frozen-after-approval>
45	
46	## Code Map
47	
48	- `lib/features/entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart` -- new, port + impl
49	- `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/pending_entry_write.dart` -- new value class
50	- `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/sync_badge_state.dart` -- new sealed class + `deriveSyncBadgeState()`
51	- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` -- `create()` signature the tracker mirrors/wraps
52	- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/sync_badge.dart` -- new, dot + label + retry widget
53	- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entry_record_card.dart` -- add badge + retry callback
54	- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_{state,cubit}.dart` -- merge `pendingWrites` stream with confirmed entries, retry handler
55	- `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` -- register tracker
56	- `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/{text,audio,photo}_entry_cubit.dart` -- swap `EntriesRepository` dep for tracker
57	- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart` -- inject tracker into the three cubit factories
58	- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart` -- existing `retryable` getter, reused as-is
59	- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- existing colors/tap-target token, reused as-is
60	- `lib/features/auth/data/repositories/session_repository_impl.dart:69-89` -- replay-stream pattern to mirror
61	- `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`, `error-taxonomy.md` -- authoritative semantics, read-only
62	
63	## Tasks & Acceptance
64	
65	**Execution:**
66	- [x] `pending_entry_write.dart` -- new value class, hand-rolled equality (existing convention)
67	- [x] `sync_badge_state.dart` -- new sealed state + pure derivation fn + unit tests (all 3 states, null/non-null combos)
68	- [x] `pending_entry_write_tracker.dart` -- port + impl, replay-capable stream, `create()`/`retry()`
69	- [x] `entries_injection.dart` -- register tracker `lazySingleton`
70	- [x] `{text,audio,photo}_entry_cubit.dart` + `capture_injection.dart` -- depend on tracker instead of `EntriesRepository`
71	- [x] `sync_badge.dart` -- new widget, dot + accessible label + ≥44pt retry target
72	- [x] `entry_record_card.dart` -- render badge, wire retry callback
73	- [x] `meus_registros_{state,cubit}.dart` -- subscribe to `pendingWrites`, merge/dedupe, expose retry method
74	- [x] Tests: tracker (create/confirm/fail/retry), derivation fn edge cases, cubit merge/dedupe + retry, widget (badge states, tap targets, non-retryable has no tap)
75	
76	**Acceptance Criteria:**
77	- [x] Given a capture save in flight, when it's not yet confirmed, then its card shows the Synchronizing badge until the server confirms, then Synchronized.
78	- [x] Given a failed retryable write, when the badge is tapped, then the same write replays and the badge updates on the new result.
79	- [x] Given a failed non-retryable write, when the badge is tapped, then an inline explanation shows and no network call fires.
80	- [x] Given a failed write, when the user retries by saving again from the same still-open capture modal (not via the badge), then the superseded failed record is dropped — no duplicate ghost card remains (`pending_entry_write_tracker_test.dart`'s "spec amendment" group).
81	
82	### Review Findings
83	
84	- [x] [Review][Patch] `tracker.retry()` has no internal `retryable` guard — invariant enforced only in `SyncBadge`'s `onTap`; add the same check inside `PendingEntryWriteTrackerImpl.retry()` for defense-in-depth [pending_entry_write_tracker.dart:180] — fixed: `retry()` now checks `failedStatus.failure.retryable` itself before replaying.
85	- [x] [Review][Patch] No widget test exercises the full chain: tap a rendered error `SyncBadge` inside a real `MeusRegistrosScreen` → `MeusRegistrosCubit.retry(entry.id)`; a regression in `onRetryTap: (entry) => widget.cubit.retry(entry.id)` would ship undetected [meus_registros_screen.dart:109] — fixed: added `meus_registros_screen_test.dart`'s new "retry wiring (spec-4-2, screen-level)" group with a controllable tracker fake.

---
title: 'Story 4.2: Per-Entry Sync Badge'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'done'
review_loop_iteration: 2
context: []
baseline_commit: '5b3ba873db3a254e34ad44613d085dcdb0fb4f2e'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** A capture write (Epic 3) is a blocking round trip with no trace on Meus Registros: a failed write vanishes silently (only the capture modal's own local error shows), and nothing on a listed card tells the user whether what they wrote is actually saved server-side.

**Approach:** Introduce one shared in-memory `PendingEntryWriteTracker` domain port that the three capture cubits and `MeusRegistrosCubit` both consume. Capture cubits route `create()` through it (optimistic pending record before the call, resolved/failed after); `MeusRegistrosCubit` overlays the tracker's live pending writes on its confirmed list. One pure derivation function (`entries/domain`) computes each card's badge from `Entry.serverRevision`/`updatedAt` plus matching pending-write status, per `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`. Tapping an error badge retries through the same tracker when retryable; otherwise shows inline explanation only.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- New port + impl `entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart` (pure Dart, RNF06 — no Flutter/data import; mirrors `SessionExpiryNotifier` pattern). API: `Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source, int? mediaDurationSeconds})` (identical contract to `EntriesRepository.create()` today — capture cubits swap the dependency, no call-site logic change); `Future<void> retry(String tempId)`; `Stream<List<PendingEntryWrite>> get pendingWrites` — replay-capable (`Stream.multi` + cached last value, mirror `SessionRepositoryImpl.statusStream`, `session_repository_impl.dart:69-89`) so a late subscriber sees current pending state immediately.
- New value class `entries/domain/entities/pending_entry_write.dart`: `{tempId, content, source, mediaDurationSeconds, startedAt, status}`, `status` = `inFlight` or `failed(Failure)`. On `create()` success: tracker drops the record; `MeusRegistrosCubit` prepends the confirmed `Entry` into its own state (existing `_dedupedById` absorbs a later duplicate from `list()`). On failure: record flips `failed`, persists only in memory until `retry()` succeeds (no queued/offline write — UX-DR30, sync-badge.md: nothing survives restart).
- `create()` first drops any existing `failed`-status record before registering the new `inFlight` one (never more than one failed record at a time). Safe because exactly one Insertion Modal exists app-wide (one factory-scoped cubit, reset on each open — UX-DR26, UX-DR36), so there is only ever one "live" capture lineage: a user retrying by tapping "Salvar" again in the same still-open modal (not via the badge) must not leave the superseded attempt's error card as a permanent orphan on Meus Registros.
- One derivation fn `deriveSyncBadgeState(Entry? entry, PendingEntryWrite? pending)` in `entries/domain/entities/sync_badge_state.dart`, pure, returns sealed `SyncBadgeState` (`synchronizing | synchronized | error(Failure)`) (AD-10) — the only place this logic lives.
- Register tracker `lazySingleton` in `entries_injection.dart` (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s own registration); inject into `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`/`PhotoEntryCubit` (`capture_injection.dart`, replacing their direct `EntriesRepository.create()` call) and into `MeusRegistrosCubit` — constructor injection only, never cubit-to-cubit (AD-7).
- `EntryRecordCard` gains a badge (dot: `colorWarningSync`/`colorSuccess`/`colorError`, `design_tokens.dart:51,54,57`) + accessible label on tap/long-focus; retry hit area uses `DesignTokens.insertionModalTapTargetMin` (`design_tokens.dart:283`), scoped to the badge's own sub-widget only — the card itself stays non-tappable-for-navigation (Story 4.4's job).
- Tap on `error` badge: if `failure.retryable` (existing getter, `lib/core/failure/failure.dart`) call `tracker.retry(tempId)`; else render inline explanation text, no tap affordance.

**Ask First:** none — scope above is complete per investigation.

**Never:** persisting pending writes; a second retry endpoint (retry replays `create()` verbatim); any screen recomputing badge state inline; `EntryRecordCard` becoming navigation-tappable.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Fresh save | Capture cubit calls `tracker.create()` | Card appears top-of-today, ochre "Synchronizing" badge, before server responds | N/A |
| Write confirmed | `create()` resolves `Right(entry)` | Pending record removed, entry prepended, badge flips green "Synchronized" | N/A |
| Write fails, retryable | `create()` resolves `Left(networkTimeout)` | Card stays, red "Synchronization error" badge | Tap calls `tracker.retry(tempId)`, re-sends same payload |
| Write fails, non-retryable | `create()` resolves `Left(validation)` | Red badge, inline explanation on tap | No network call on tap |
| App restarts mid-pending | Pending write existed, app killed | Pending card is gone (not persisted) | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart` -- new, port + impl
- `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/pending_entry_write.dart` -- new value class
- `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/sync_badge_state.dart` -- new sealed class + `deriveSyncBadgeState()`
- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` -- `create()` signature the tracker mirrors/wraps
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/sync_badge.dart` -- new, dot + label + retry widget
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entry_record_card.dart` -- add badge + retry callback
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_{state,cubit}.dart` -- merge `pendingWrites` stream with confirmed entries, retry handler
- `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` -- register tracker
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/{text,audio,photo}_entry_cubit.dart` -- swap `EntriesRepository` dep for tracker
- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart` -- inject tracker into the three cubit factories
- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart` -- existing `retryable` getter, reused as-is
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- existing colors/tap-target token, reused as-is
- `lib/features/auth/data/repositories/session_repository_impl.dart:69-89` -- replay-stream pattern to mirror

14	
15	**Problem:** Entries from text/audio/photo capture (Epic 3) are invisible — "Meus Registros" is still the Epic 1 placeholder, and `EntriesRepository` only has `create`.

25	- Group by `occurredAt.toLocal()` truncated to day, never `createdAt`. Grouping fn is pure Dart (no flutter import, RNF06) in `entries/domain`; day labels are presentation's job.

97	- [x] [Review][Defer] `_onScroll`'s pre-fetch buffer reuses `DesignTokens.spacing2xl` (a visual spacing token) as a scroll-pixel threshold, conflating a behavioral constant with the visual token scale [`meus_registros_screen.dart:77`](../../lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart#L77) — deferred, cosmetic

101	## Design Notes
102	
103	Code-review clarification (not a frozen-intent change): the Boundaries' offline/timeout Hive-fallback rule and the I/O matrix's "Scroll pagination: fetch failure keeps current items + inline retry" row only fully co-exist when the fallback is scoped to `cursor == null` (the first/fresh page). `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` must apply `_offlineFallback()` only for that case; a paginated call (`cursor != null`) that fails with `networkOffline`/`networkTimeout` propagates as `Left` like any other pagination failure, so `MeusRegistrosCubit._fetchMore()`'s existing `loadMoreFailed`/retry path handles it uniformly — otherwise a connectivity drop mid-scroll silently merges an unrelated full-cache dump into the paginated list and breaks its newest-first ordering.

**Execution:**
- [x] `entries/domain/entities/entries_page.dart` -- new `EntriesPage{items, nextCursor}`
- [x] `entries/domain/entities/entry_date_group.dart` -- new `EntryDateGroup{date, entries}` + pure `groupEntriesByDate()`

- [x] `lib/core/widgets/skeleton_box.dart` -- new generic shimmer, tokens-only

- [x] `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` -- route builds `MeusRegistrosScreen(cubit: sl())`
- [x] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` -- delete `MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen`
- [x] Tests: grouping edge cases (midnight boundary, empty), `list()` datasource/repository incl. offline, cubit, screen (skeleton timing, pagination, zero/error)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a successful load with multi-day entries, when rendered, then the list is grouped by day with each card's spine colored by `EntrySource`.
- Given offline, when the screen loads, then cached entries render with no crash or duplicates.
- Given a session expiry while visible, when the global overlay appears, then scroll position is preserved and nothing throws.

### Review Findings

- [x] [Review][Patch] `groupEntriesByDate()`'s malformed-`occurredAt` skip path is untested — a regression from `continue` to rethrow would crash the whole screen render, silently [`entry_date_group.dart:58-60`](../../lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry_date_group.dart#L58-L60) — fixed, test added + simplified to `DateTime.tryParse()`
- [x] [Review][Patch] `EntriesRepositoryImpl._offlineFallback()`'s corrupt-cached-entry catch branch is untested — a regression here would reject with a raw exception instead of `Left(malformedResponse)`, violating RNF09 and this story's own offline AC [`entries_repository_impl.dart:102-120`](../../lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart#L102-L120) — fixed, test added
- [x] [Review][Patch] Entry id de-duplication is incomplete: `loadFirstPage()` applies none at all, and `_fetchMore()`'s dedup only checks a new page against ids already held in state, not against duplicate ids within that same incoming page — contradicts the I/O matrix's "no dup ids" guarantee if the server ever repeats an id [`meus_registros_cubit.dart:44-51,103-106`](../../lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit.dart#L44-L51) — fixed via shared `_dedupedById()`, tests added

- [x] [Review][Patch] When every entry in a non-empty `MeusRegistrosLoaded` state has an unparsable `occurredAt`, `groups` is empty and `_EntryList` renders a blank list (no "no entries" message, no error) despite entries existing in memory [`meus_registros_screen.dart:207-224`](../../lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart#L207-L224) — fixed, falls back to the plain empty-state text
- [x] [Review][Patch] Frozen Acceptance Criterion 3 (session-expiry + scroll-position preservation) has no automated test — only a doc-comment architectural argument, with nothing mounting the screen under `ExpiryOverlayHost`, scrolling, triggering expiry, and asserting no crash/scroll-loss [`meus_registros_screen.dart:23-28`](../../lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart#L23-L28) — fixed, test added

- [x] [Review][Defer] `_listEquals` is hand-copied verbatim into three new files (`entries_page.dart`, `entry_date_group.dart`, `meus_registros_state.dart`), and the `==`/`hashCode`/`toString()` triplet is hand-rolled on four new value classes with no shared base — deferred, pre-existing pattern extended, not a correctness bug
- [x] [Review][Defer] `MeusRegistrosLoaded.groups` recomputes `groupEntriesByDate(entries)` from scratch on every access, including footer-only rebuilds during pagination, with no caching or ceiling as the list grows — deferred, performance-only, dataset currently small

## Design Notes

Code-review clarification (not a frozen-intent change): the Boundaries' offline/timeout Hive-fallback rule and the I/O matrix's "Scroll pagination: fetch failure keeps current items + inline retry" row only fully co-exist when the fallback is scoped to `cursor == null` (the first/fresh page). `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` must apply `_offlineFallback()` only for that case; a paginated call (`cursor != null`) that fails with `networkOffline`/`networkTimeout` propagates as `Left` like any other pagination failure, so `MeusRegistrosCubit._fetchMore()`'s existing `loadMoreFailed`/retry path handles it uniformly — otherwise a connectivity drop mid-scroll silently merges an unrelated full-cache dump into the paginated list and breaks its newest-first ordering.

- `_fetchMore` — dedup by id, plus the degenerate-cursor guard (review fix): zero genuinely-new items forces `nextCursor: null` so a stuck server cursor can't retrigger forever.
  [`meus_registros_cubit.dart:75`](../../lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit.dart#L75)

13:The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).
25:  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
29:Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
30:  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
32:  └─ overlay: export card (download icon) ──> pending ──> processing ──> done | error | empty period
48:Names as they appear in the prototype. The prototype's own state catalog has 32 entries: Tela 0 — Splash; Tela 0.1 — Biometria; Tela 0.1a — Entrar / criar conta; Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial; Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha; Tela 1 — Home / Chat; Tela 2 — Texto, Áudio (Gravando, Processando, Transcrito, Erro), Foto (Captura, Processando OCR, Reconhecido, Erro); Tela 3 — Menu lateral; Tela 1 — Sessão expirada; Tela 4 — Meus Registros, Estado vazio, Sheet de filtro, Filtros ativos; Exportar — Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio; Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]**; Tela 6 — Configurações, Dashboard zero entradas, Dashboard uma entrada, Narrativa indisponível, Confirmar exclusão. The tables below group them by screen; some rows describe variations inside one state (e.g., the bookmark sub-states, the streaming response). Extension states (requirements, section 2) are marked **[ext]**.
70:| Tela 3 — Menu lateral | Drawer: initials avatar and name; section "CONVERSAS" with past sessions (title + timestamp); items "Meus Registros", "Planos de Ação", "Configurações"; new-conversation action. |
90:| Tela 4 — Meus Registros (default) | Records grouped by date ("Hoje", "Ontem", dates); each card with a spine colored by origin, source icon, time, sync indicator (green "sincronizado" / ochre "sincronizando" / red "erro de sync"), text excerpt, category chips when present; header with back arrow, title, download icon; search bar "Buscar nos registros..." with a funnel button. |
91:| Tela 4 — Vazio | Large notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", CTA "Criar primeiro registro". |
102:| Período vazio | "Nenhum registro nesse período." and a suggestion to adjust the filter; no download button. |
171:2. Entry origin in "Meus Registros" — color by type: manual = dark green, audio = olive green, photo = gray, chat = ochre.
200:5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
213:| Text field | Login, Texto tab, name editing | empty · focused (1.5px `#1F3D34` border) · error (`#B3402A` border) |
225:| Bar chart (dashboard) | Configurações | populated (10 bars) · one bar · empty (placeholder icon) |
226:| Export status card | Tela 4 (bottom sheet) | pending · processing · done · error · empty |

---
title: 'Story 4.3: Empty-State Handling'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Story 4.1 deliberately shipped `MeusRegistrosEmpty` with only plain "no entries yet" text and explicitly deferred a polished CTA to this story (FR-16) — a user with zero Entries currently has no path back to capture from this screen, only a static sentence.

**Approach:** Replace `_EmptyState`'s plain text with the prototype's dedicated empty state (Tela 4 — Vazio): notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda" copy, and a primary CTA button ("Criar primeiro registro") that opens the same Insertion Modal the Home/Chat "+" FAB already opens. No cubit/state changes — `MeusRegistrosCubit` already emits `MeusRegistrosEmpty` correctly (spec-4-2); this is presentation-only.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Exact prototype markup (`cerne-prototype.html`'s Tela 4 — Vazio block): `ph-notebook` icon (88px, `colorBorder`) → `Icons.menu_book_outlined` (no icon-font dependency, same approximation convention as `DesignTokens.dialogIconSize`/`biometricIconSize`); text "Nenhum registro ainda" (`textBodyMd`/`colorTextSecondary`, exact prototype copy — no added period); CTA "Criar primeiro registro" as `AppButton(variant: AppButtonVariant.primary)` (bg `colorPrimary`/text `colorOnPrimary`/`radiusSm` already match the prototype's button exactly).
- New token `DesignTokens.entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88` (RNF08 — no raw literal in the widget); gap between icon/text/button uses `DesignTokens.spacingMd` (prototype's `gap:16px`).
- CTA `onPressed` calls `InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>(), audioCubit: sl<AudioEntryCubit>(), photoCubit: sl<PhotoEntryCubit>())` — identical call shape to the Home/Chat FAB (`placeholder_screens.dart:97-102`), fresh factory-scoped cubits per tap. No explicit reload after the modal closes: a resulting capture flows through the shared `PendingEntryWriteTracker`, which `MeusRegistrosCubit` already subscribes to for its whole lifetime (spec-4-2) — it transitions out of `MeusRegistrosEmpty` on its own.
- `_EmptyState` stays the single widget both `MeusRegistrosEmpty()` and `_EntryList`'s `groups.isEmpty` fallback (malformed-`occurredAt` case, spec-4-1 review fix) render — no second empty-state implementation.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by the prototype and spec-4-2's existing tracker wiring.

**Never:** any `MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosState` change; a second way to open the Insertion Modal; an explicit `loadFirstPage()` re-call after the modal closes (the tracker overlay already handles it).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Zero entries, first load | `MeusRegistrosEmpty` emitted | Icon + "Nenhum registro ainda" + CTA render | N/A |
| CTA tapped | User taps "Criar primeiro registro" | Insertion Modal opens (Texto/Áudio/Foto tabs), same as Home FAB | N/A |
| Save from empty-state-opened modal | Capture succeeds | Modal closes; screen transitions to `MeusRegistrosLoaded` via the tracker's existing `confirmedWrites`/`pendingWrites` overlay (spec-4-2) — no new wiring | N/A |
| All entries have malformed `occurredAt` | `MeusRegistrosLoaded` but `groups.isEmpty` | Same `_EmptyState` (icon + text + CTA), not blank | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:141-157` -- `_EmptyState` — replace plain `Text` with icon + text + `AppButton` CTA; add imports for `AppButton`, `InsertionModal`, the three capture cubits, and `sl`
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart:266` (near `biometricIconCircleSize`) -- add `entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88`
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- reuse `AppButton(variant: AppButtonVariant.primary)` as-is, no changes
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:63-68` -- `InsertionModal.show()` signature to call verbatim
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart:96-107` -- the exact call shape to mirror (Home FAB)
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- `sl` accessor, already registers `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`/`PhotoEntryCubit` as factories
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_state.dart:23-27` -- `MeusRegistrosEmpty` doc comment referencing "no polished CTA — that's story 4.3" — update now that this story resolves it
- `test/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen_test.dart:250,271,296,573` -- update `'Nenhum registro ainda.'` assertions (drop the period to match exact prototype copy) and the now-obsolete "no polished CTA this story" test description (line ~262)
- `test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart:169-202` -- the existing FAB-tap-opens-modal test pattern (fakes + `resetCoreDependencies()`) to mirror for the new CTA test

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `design_tokens.dart` -- add `entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88` with a doc comment citing Tela 4 — Vazio's `ph-notebook` 88px icon
- [ ] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- rewrite `_EmptyState`: `Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined, size: entriesEmptyStateIconSize, color: colorBorder)`, `SizedBox(height: spacingMd)`, `Text('Nenhum registro ainda', style: textBodyMd.copyWith(color: colorTextSecondary))`, `SizedBox(height: spacingMd)`, `AppButton(label: 'Criar primeiro registro', onPressed: () => InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>(), audioCubit: sl<AudioEntryCubit>(), photoCubit: sl<PhotoEntryCubit>()))`
- [ ] `meus_registros_state.dart` -- update `MeusRegistrosEmpty`'s doc comment (drop the forward reference to this now-complete story)
- [ ] `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` -- update the 4 existing `'Nenhum registro ainda.'` assertions to the no-period copy; rename/update the "no polished CTA this story" test; add a test asserting the icon + CTA button render in the empty state; add a test (mirroring `placeholder_screens_test.dart`'s fakes) that tapping the CTA opens the Insertion Modal (asserts `find.text('Texto')`/`'Áudio'`/`'Foto'`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given zero Entries, when Meus Registros loads, then a dedicated empty state renders (icon, copy, CTA) — never a blank list or plain-text-only state.
- Given the empty state, when the user taps "Criar primeiro registro", then the Insertion Modal opens, identical to the Home/Chat "+" FAB's own modal.

## Design Notes

The CTA deliberately calls `InsertionModal.show` directly from `_EmptyState` (a `StatelessWidget`, same as `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`'s FAB) rather than threading a callback through `MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosScreen` — opening the modal is pure navigation/DI wiring with no cubit-observable state of its own, and `placeholder_screens.dart` already establishes this exact call-directly-from-the-widget convention for the only other place this modal is opened.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- With zero Entries, open Meus Registros: confirm the icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", and the CTA render; tap the CTA and confirm the Insertion Modal opens with its three tabs.

**Execution:**
- [ ] `design_tokens.dart` -- add `entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88` with a doc comment citing Tela 4 — Vazio's `ph-notebook` 88px icon

4. Set `development_status[{story_key}]` to `{target_status}`.
5. **Epic lift (only when `target_status` = `in-progress`).** Derive the parent epic key as `epic-{N}` from the leading numeric segment of `{story_key}` (e.g., `3-2-digest-delivery` → `epic-3`). 6. Refresh `last_updated` to the current date.
7. Save the file, preserving ALL comments and structure including STATUS DEFINITIONS and WORKFLOW NOTES.

---
title: 'Story 4.3: Empty-State Handling'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'in-progress'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '526b6bf0085b1ff5c0f70f9d567833633caf5248'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Story 4.1 deliberately shipped `MeusRegistrosEmpty` with only plain "no entries yet" text and explicitly deferred a polished CTA to this story (FR-16) — a user with zero Entries currently has no path back to capture from this screen, only a static sentence.

**Approach:** Replace `_EmptyState`'s plain text with the prototype's dedicated empty state (Tela 4 — Vazio): notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda" copy, and a primary CTA button ("Criar primeiro registro") that opens the same Insertion Modal the Home/Chat "+" FAB already opens. No cubit/state changes — `MeusRegistrosCubit` already emits `MeusRegistrosEmpty` correctly (spec-4-2); this is presentation-only.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Exact prototype markup (`cerne-prototype.html`'s Tela 4 — Vazio block): `ph-notebook` icon (88px, `colorBorder`) → `Icons.menu_book_outlined` (no icon-font dependency, same approximation convention as `DesignTokens.dialogIconSize`/`biometricIconSize`); text "Nenhum registro ainda" (`textBodyMd`/`colorTextSecondary`, exact prototype copy — no added period); CTA "Criar primeiro registro" as `AppButton(variant: AppButtonVariant.primary)` (bg `colorPrimary`/text `colorOnPrimary`/`radiusSm` already match the prototype's button exactly).
- New token `DesignTokens.entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88` (RNF08 — no raw literal in the widget); gap between icon/text/button uses `DesignTokens.spacingMd` (prototype's `gap:16px`).
- CTA `onPressed` calls `InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>(), audioCubit: sl<AudioEntryCubit>(), photoCubit: sl<PhotoEntryCubit>())` — identical call shape to the Home/Chat FAB (`placeholder_screens.dart:97-102`), fresh factory-scoped cubits per tap. No explicit reload after the modal closes: a resulting capture flows through the shared `PendingEntryWriteTracker`, which `MeusRegistrosCubit` already subscribes to for its whole lifetime (spec-4-2) — it transitions out of `MeusRegistrosEmpty` on its own.
- `_EmptyState` stays the single widget both `MeusRegistrosEmpty()` and `_EntryList`'s `groups.isEmpty` fallback (malformed-`occurredAt` case, spec-4-1 review fix) render — no second empty-state implementation.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by the prototype and spec-4-2's existing tracker wiring.

**Never:** any `MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosState` change; a second way to open the Insertion Modal; an explicit `loadFirstPage()` re-call after the modal closes (the tracker overlay already handles it).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Zero entries, first load | `MeusRegistrosEmpty` emitted | Icon + "Nenhum registro ainda" + CTA render | N/A |
| CTA tapped | User taps "Criar primeiro registro" | Insertion Modal opens (Texto/Áudio/Foto tabs), same as Home FAB | N/A |
| Save from empty-state-opened modal | Capture succeeds | Modal closes; screen transitions to `MeusRegistrosLoaded` via the tracker's existing `confirmedWrites`/`pendingWrites` overlay (spec-4-2) — no new wiring | N/A |
| All entries have malformed `occurredAt` | `MeusRegistrosLoaded` but `groups.isEmpty` | Same `_EmptyState` (icon + text + CTA), not blank | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:141-157` -- `_EmptyState` — replace plain `Text` with icon + text + `AppButton` CTA; add imports for `AppButton`, `InsertionModal`, the three capture cubits, and `sl`
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart:266` (near `biometricIconCircleSize`) -- add `entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88`
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- reuse `AppButton(variant: AppButtonVariant.primary)` as-is, no changes
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:63-68` -- `InsertionModal.show()` signature to call verbatim
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart:96-107` -- the exact call shape to mirror (Home FAB)
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- `sl` accessor, already registers `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`/`PhotoEntryCubit` as factories
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_state.dart:23-27` -- `MeusRegistrosEmpty` doc comment referencing "no polished CTA — that's story 4.3" — update now that this story resolves it
- `test/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen_test.dart:250,271,296,573` -- update `'Nenhum registro ainda.'` assertions (drop the period to match exact prototype copy) and the now-obsolete "no polished CTA this story" test description (line ~262)
- `test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart:169-202` -- the existing FAB-tap-opens-modal test pattern (fakes + `resetCoreDependencies()`) to mirror for the new CTA test

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `design_tokens.dart` -- add `entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88` with a doc comment citing Tela 4 — Vazio's `ph-notebook` 88px icon
- [ ] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- rewrite `_EmptyState`: `Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined, size: entriesEmptyStateIconSize, color: colorBorder)`, `SizedBox(height: spacingMd)`, `Text('Nenhum registro ainda', style: textBodyMd.copyWith(color: colorTextSecondary))`, `SizedBox(height: spacingMd)`, `AppButton(label: 'Criar primeiro registro', onPressed: () => InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>(), audioCubit: sl<AudioEntryCubit>(), photoCubit: sl<PhotoEntryCubit>()))`
- [ ] `meus_registros_state.dart` -- update `MeusRegistrosEmpty`'s doc comment (drop the forward reference to this now-complete story)
- [ ] `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` -- update the 4 existing `'Nenhum registro ainda.'` assertions to the no-period copy; rename/update the "no polished CTA this story" test; add a test asserting the icon + CTA button render in the empty state; add a test (mirroring `placeholder_screens_test.dart`'s fakes) that tapping the CTA opens the Insertion Modal (asserts `find.text('Texto')`/`'Áudio'`/`'Foto'`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given zero Entries, when Meus Registros loads, then a dedicated empty state renders (icon, copy, CTA) — never a blank list or plain-text-only state.
- Given the empty state, when the user taps "Criar primeiro registro", then the Insertion Modal opens, identical to the Home/Chat "+" FAB's own modal.

## Design Notes

The CTA deliberately calls `InsertionModal.show` directly from `_EmptyState` (a `StatelessWidget`, same as `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`'s FAB) rather than threading a callback through `MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosScreen` — opening the modal is pure navigation/DI wiring with no cubit-observable state of its own, and `placeholder_screens.dart` already establishes this exact call-directly-from-the-widget convention for the only other place this modal is opened.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- With zero Entries, open Meus Registros: confirm the icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", and the CTA render; tap the CTA and confirm the Insertion Modal opens with its three tabs.

---
title: 'Story 4.3: Empty-State Handling'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'in-progress'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '526b6bf0085b1ff5c0f70f9d567833633caf5248'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Story 4.1 deliberately shipped `MeusRegistrosEmpty` with only plain "no entries yet" text and explicitly deferred a polished CTA to this story (FR-16) — a user with zero Entries currently has no path back to capture from this screen, only a static sentence.

**Approach:** Replace `_EmptyState`'s plain text with the prototype's dedicated empty state (Tela 4 — Vazio): notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda" copy, and a primary CTA button ("Criar primeiro registro") that opens the same Insertion Modal the Home/Chat "+" FAB already opens. No cubit/state changes — `MeusRegistrosCubit` already emits `MeusRegistrosEmpty` correctly (spec-4-2); this is presentation-only.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Exact prototype markup (`cerne-prototype.html`'s Tela 4 — Vazio block): `ph-notebook` icon (88px, `colorBorder`) → `Icons.menu_book_outlined` (no icon-font dependency, same approximation convention as `DesignTokens.dialogIconSize`/`biometricIconSize`); text "Nenhum registro ainda" (`textBodyMd`/`colorTextSecondary`, exact prototype copy — no added period); CTA "Criar primeiro registro" as `AppButton(variant: AppButtonVariant.primary)` (bg `colorPrimary`/text `colorOnPrimary`/`radiusSm` already match the prototype's button exactly).
- New token `DesignTokens.entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88` (RNF08 — no raw literal in the widget); gap between icon/text/button uses `DesignTokens.spacingMd` (prototype's `gap:16px`).
- CTA `onPressed` calls `InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>(), audioCubit: sl<AudioEntryCubit>(), photoCubit: sl<PhotoEntryCubit>())` — identical call shape to the Home/Chat FAB (`placeholder_screens.dart:97-102`), fresh factory-scoped cubits per tap. No explicit reload after the modal closes: a resulting capture flows through the shared `PendingEntryWriteTracker`, which `MeusRegistrosCubit` already subscribes to for its whole lifetime (spec-4-2) — it transitions out of `MeusRegistrosEmpty` on its own.
- `_EmptyState` stays the single widget both `MeusRegistrosEmpty()` and `_EntryList`'s `groups.isEmpty` fallback (malformed-`occurredAt` case, spec-4-1 review fix) render — no second empty-state implementation.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by the prototype and spec-4-2's existing tracker wiring.

**Never:** any `MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosState` change; a second way to open the Insertion Modal; an explicit `loadFirstPage()` re-call after the modal closes (the tracker overlay already handles it).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Zero entries, first load | `MeusRegistrosEmpty` emitted | Icon + "Nenhum registro ainda" + CTA render | N/A |
| CTA tapped | User taps "Criar primeiro registro" | Insertion Modal opens (Texto/Áudio/Foto tabs), same as Home FAB | N/A |
| Save from empty-state-opened modal | Capture succeeds | Modal closes; screen transitions to `MeusRegistrosLoaded` via the tracker's existing `confirmedWrites`/`pendingWrites` overlay (spec-4-2) — no new wiring | N/A |
| All entries have malformed `occurredAt` | `MeusRegistrosLoaded` but `groups.isEmpty` | Same `_EmptyState` (icon + text + CTA), not blank | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:141-157` -- `_EmptyState` — replace plain `Text` with icon + text + `AppButton` CTA; add imports for `AppButton`, `InsertionModal`, the three capture cubits, and `sl`
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart:266` (near `biometricIconCircleSize`) -- add `entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88`
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- reuse `AppButton(variant: AppButtonVariant.primary)` as-is, no changes
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:63-68` -- `InsertionModal.show()` signature to call verbatim
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart:96-107` -- the exact call shape to mirror (Home FAB)
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- `sl` accessor, already registers `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`/`PhotoEntryCubit` as factories
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_state.dart:23-27` -- `MeusRegistrosEmpty` doc comment referencing "no polished CTA — that's story 4.3" — update now that this story resolves it
- `test/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen_test.dart:250,271,296,573` -- update `'Nenhum registro ainda.'` assertions (drop the period to match exact prototype copy) and the now-obsolete "no polished CTA this story" test description (line ~262)
- `test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart:169-202` -- the existing FAB-tap-opens-modal test pattern (fakes + `resetCoreDependencies()`) to mirror for the new CTA test

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- add `entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88` with a doc comment citing Tela 4 — Vazio's `ph-notebook` 88px icon
- [x] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- rewrite `_EmptyState`: `Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined, size: entriesEmptyStateIconSize, color: colorBorder)`, `SizedBox(height: spacingMd)`, `Text('Nenhum registro ainda', style: textBodyMd.copyWith(color: colorTextSecondary))`, `SizedBox(height: spacingMd)`, `AppButton(label: 'Criar primeiro registro', onPressed: () => InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>(), audioCubit: sl<AudioEntryCubit>(), photoCubit: sl<PhotoEntryCubit>()))`
- [x] `meus_registros_state.dart` -- update `MeusRegistrosEmpty`'s doc comment (drop the forward reference to this now-complete story)
- [x] `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` -- update the 4 existing `'Nenhum registro ainda.'` assertions to the no-period copy; rename/update the "no polished CTA this story" test; add a test asserting the icon + CTA button render in the empty state; add a test (mirroring `placeholder_screens_test.dart`'s fakes) that tapping the CTA opens the Insertion Modal (asserts `find.text('Texto')`/`'Áudio'`/`'Foto'`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [x] Given zero Entries, when Meus Registros loads, then a dedicated empty state renders (icon, copy, CTA) — never a blank list or plain-text-only state.
- [x] Given the empty state, when the user taps "Criar primeiro registro", then the Insertion Modal opens, identical to the Home/Chat "+" FAB's own modal.

## Design Notes

The CTA deliberately calls `InsertionModal.show` directly from `_EmptyState` (a `StatelessWidget`, same as `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`'s FAB) rather than threading a callback through `MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosScreen` — opening the modal is pure navigation/DI wiring with no cubit-observable state of its own, and `placeholder_screens.dart` already establishes this exact call-directly-from-the-widget convention for the only other place this modal is opened.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- With zero Entries, open Meus Registros: confirm the icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", and the CTA render; tap the CTA and confirm the Insertion Modal opens with its three tabs.

</agent-message>

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Story 4.1 deliberately shipped `MeusRegistrosEmpty` with only plain "no entries yet" text and explicitly deferred a polished CTA to this story (FR-16) — a user with zero Entries currently has no path back to capture from this screen, only a static sentence.

**Approach:** Replace `_EmptyState`'s plain text with the prototype's dedicated empty state (Tela 4 — Vazio): notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda" copy, and a primary CTA button ("Criar primeiro registro") that opens the same Insertion Modal the Home/Chat "+" FAB already opens. No cubit/state changes — `MeusRegistrosCubit` already emits `MeusRegistrosEmpty` correctly (spec-4-2); this is presentation-only.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Exact prototype markup (`cerne-prototype.html`'s Tela 4 — Vazio block): `ph-notebook` icon (88px, `colorBorder`) → `Icons.menu_book_outlined` (no icon-font dependency, same approximation convention as `DesignTokens.dialogIconSize`/`biometricIconSize`); text "Nenhum registro ainda" (`textBodyMd`/`colorTextSecondary`, exact prototype copy — no added period); CTA "Criar primeiro registro" as `AppButton(variant: AppButtonVariant.primary)` (bg `colorPrimary`/text `colorOnPrimary`/`radiusSm` already match the prototype's button exactly).
- New token `DesignTokens.entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88` (RNF08 — no raw literal in the widget); gap between icon/text/button uses `DesignTokens.spacingMd` (prototype's `gap:16px`).
- CTA `onPressed` calls `InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>(), audioCubit: sl<AudioEntryCubit>(), photoCubit: sl<PhotoEntryCubit>())` — identical call shape to the Home/Chat FAB (`placeholder_screens.dart:97-102`), fresh factory-scoped cubits per tap. No explicit reload after the modal closes: a resulting capture flows through the shared `PendingEntryWriteTracker`, which `MeusRegistrosCubit` already subscribes to for its whole lifetime (spec-4-2) — it transitions out of `MeusRegistrosEmpty` on its own.
- `_EmptyState` stays the single widget both `MeusRegistrosEmpty()` and `_EntryList`'s `groups.isEmpty` fallback (malformed-`occurredAt` case, spec-4-1 review fix) render — no second empty-state implementation.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by the prototype and spec-4-2's existing tracker wiring.

**Never:** any `MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosState` change; a second way to open the Insertion Modal; an explicit `loadFirstPage()` re-call after the modal closes (the tracker overlay already handles it).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Zero entries, first load | `MeusRegistrosEmpty` emitted | Icon + "Nenhum registro ainda" + CTA render | N/A |
| CTA tapped | User taps "Criar primeiro registro" | Insertion Modal opens (Texto/Áudio/Foto tabs), same as Home FAB | N/A |
| Save from empty-state-opened modal | Capture succeeds | Modal closes; screen transitions to `MeusRegistrosLoaded` via the tracker's existing `confirmedWrites`/`pendingWrites` overlay (spec-4-2) — no new wiring | N/A |
| All entries have malformed `occurredAt` | `MeusRegistrosLoaded` but `groups.isEmpty` | Same `_EmptyState` (icon + text + CTA), not blank | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:141-157` -- `_EmptyState` — replace plain `Text` with icon + text + `AppButton` CTA; add imports for `AppButton`, `InsertionModal`, the three capture cubits, and `sl`
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart:266` (near `biometricIconCircleSize`) -- add `entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88`
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- reuse `AppButton(variant: AppButtonVariant.primary)` as-is, no changes
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart:63-68` -- `InsertionModal.show()` signature to call verbatim
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart:96-107` -- the exact call shape to mirror (Home FAB)
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- `sl` accessor, already registers `TextEntryCubit`/`AudioEntryCubit`/`PhotoEntryCubit` as factories
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_state.dart:23-27` -- `MeusRegistrosEmpty` doc comment referencing "no polished CTA — that's story 4.3" — update now that this story resolves it
- `test/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen_test.dart:250,271,296,573` -- update `'Nenhum registro ainda.'` assertions (drop the period to match exact prototype copy) and the now-obsolete "no polished CTA this story" test description (line ~262)
- `test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart:169-202` -- the existing FAB-tap-opens-modal test pattern (fakes + `resetCoreDependencies()`) to mirror for the new CTA test

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- add `entriesEmptyStateIconSize = 88` with a doc comment citing Tela 4 — Vazio's `ph-notebook` 88px icon
- [x] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- rewrite `_EmptyState`: `Icon(Icons.menu_book_outlined, size: entriesEmptyStateIconSize, color: colorBorder)`, `SizedBox(height: spacingMd)`, `Text('Nenhum registro ainda', style: textBodyMd.copyWith(color: colorTextSecondary))`, `SizedBox(height: spacingMd)`, `AppButton(label: 'Criar primeiro registro', onPressed: () => InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>(), audioCubit: sl<AudioEntryCubit>(), photoCubit: sl<PhotoEntryCubit>()))`
- [x] `meus_registros_state.dart` -- update `MeusRegistrosEmpty`'s doc comment (drop the forward reference to this now-complete story)
- [x] `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` -- update the 4 existing `'Nenhum registro ainda.'` assertions to the no-period copy; rename/update the "no polished CTA this story" test; add a test asserting the icon + CTA button render in the empty state; add a test (mirroring `placeholder_screens_test.dart`'s fakes) that tapping the CTA opens the Insertion Modal (asserts `find.text('Texto')`/`'Áudio'`/`'Foto'`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [x] Given zero Entries, when Meus Registros loads, then a dedicated empty state renders (icon, copy, CTA) — never a blank list or plain-text-only state.
- [x] Given the empty state, when the user taps "Criar primeiro registro", then the Insertion Modal opens, identical to the Home/Chat "+" FAB's own modal.

## Design Notes

The CTA deliberately calls `InsertionModal.show` directly from `_EmptyState` (a `StatelessWidget`, same as `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen`'s FAB) rather than threading a callback through `MeusRegistrosCubit`/`MeusRegistrosScreen` — opening the modal is pure navigation/DI wiring with no cubit-observable state of its own, and `placeholder_screens.dart` already establishes this exact call-directly-from-the-widget convention for the only other place this modal is opened.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- With zero Entries, open Meus Registros: confirm the icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", and the CTA render; tap the CTA and confirm the Insertion Modal opens with its three tabs.
